variation.name: bir51_combined_comparative_pbt
variation.description: A complete BIR51 filing whose financial statements tag ProfitLossBeforeTax for two durations. The tax computation and the current-year financial statements are both 0. The prior year ended 31 March 2025 is 80 in the financial statements only. NVAD-E-1390 must not require every financial-statements profit-before-tax fact to equal the tax-computation fact.
